source_facts.fact: A pending call hides the scheduled-time card; scheduling requires pendingOFF.
New-call calendar/clock DateTimeField is shared web/native, no keyboard entry; Done commits serializePickerValue, Cancel does not commit the draft.
New-call selected datetime is an instant serialized toUTC; displayed picker uses locale/browser Date formatting. Minimum lead15minutes.
Nonpending creation, including future scheduling, navigates Home; Scheduled list verification requires separate navigation.

Reschedule sheet formats browser Date presets without zone; Core interprets its Date as department-local and converts toUTC. Static inference: browser and department zone differences may affect the apparent wall-clock roundtrip. Actual UI verification is required, not yet performed.
Scheduled Dispatch now uses confirmDispatchNow, which confirms stored recipients. Web uses window.confirm; native uses Alert.
Source endpoints exist for queued scheduled list, rescheduling and manual dispatch; success must still be observed in actual UI.
